WITH total_accounts AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) as total FROM account
),
district_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        district_id,
        COUNT(*) as account_count
    FROM account
    GROUP BY district_id
),
num_districts AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT district_id) as num_districts FROM account
),
district_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        d.district_id,
        d.account_count,
        CAST(d.account_count AS REAL) / t.total as share,
        1.0 / nd.num_districts as avg_share
    FROM district_counts d
    CROSS JOIN total_accounts t
    CROSS JOIN num_districts nd
)
SELECT 
    district_id,
    account_count,
    share,
    share - avg_share as difference
FROM district_stats
ORDER BY difference DESC
LIMIT 10;
